baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلَّمَا ... يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا ... أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا ... وَذُوقُوا
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal universal restarts an outward motion whenever it forms; enveloping distress supplies the pressure to leave, forced return cancels the vector, and tasting makes each reset a renewed embodied verification of burning.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive totality makes كُلَّمَا exhaustive rather than an isolated retry.
Back-and-forth unsettled motion gives the wish an oscillating vector before the explicit return.
Passage to an outside supplies the attempted boundary crossing.
Covering and closure turn distress into an enveloping condition that presses on the exit.
Return after departure supplies the reset that nullifies each outward passage.
Experiential testing makes punishment newly known in every cycle.
Severe punitive pain is the content repeatedly verified.
Fire and flame specify the medium of the recurring experience.

changed_reading.before: They repeatedly try to escape a fire and are put back.
changed_reading.after: The ayah operates as a closed feedback circuit: distress generates an outward vector, return cancels it, and the command to taste restarts embodied knowledge of the same burning.

baseline_models.mechanism: Ghamm can be more than an emotion: its branch field covers light, mouth, nose, and intelligible sound. Exit therefore seeks unsealing from a perceptual and respiratory enclosure, while return restores the seal.

activation_trace.role: Something encircling a place gives the repeated episode a bounded surround.
A sky clearing after cover supplies an opening-image for the desired exit.
Obscured sky and light make the distress perceptually darkening.
A cover over nose and mouth makes the enclosure somatically sealing.
Mixed unintelligible sound adds loss of communicative orientation inside the cover.

changed_reading.before: Ghamm names the anguish that motivates escape.
changed_reading.after: Ghamm is also the enclosing loss of air, light, and intelligibility from which exit would be an unsealing; being returned means re-occlusion.

baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative of tasting activates an inverted nourishment sequence: a root field containing sweetness and potable water is forced into punitive withholding and searing sensation. The punishment is intimate intake without refreshment.

activation_trace.role: Oral tasting supplies the nourishment-shaped sensory frame.
Sweet, palatable water supplies the positive pole that punishment reverses.
Abstention from food and drink turns the reversal toward deprivation.
Withholding and prevention make the tasted object anti-refreshment.
Searing sting converts the palate-shaped frame into intimate pain.

changed_reading.before: Taste is an idiom meaning undergo the burning punishment.
changed_reading.after: The command stages anti-nourishment: what reaches the sensor offers no sweetness or relief, only deprivation converted into searing experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence in 22:5 moves from enclosure through emergence as a child, growth, and a later return to diminished age. Reusing exit and return around the focus revises its loop into an anti-birth: emergence begins but cannot open into a next stage.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the attempted passage from an interior to an outside.
The focus supplies forced return after the attempted emergence.
Emergence to an outside is realized there as being brought out as a child.
Return to a prior condition supplies the regressive counterpart later in the life sequence.

structural_cues: 22:5 orders womb-like developmental stages, being brought out as a child, maturation, and return to the lowest age.
22:22 compresses attempted emergence and return into one recurring conditional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two exit-return sequences, one developmental and one punitive; I supply the anti-birth comparison, while the live alternative is that 22:5 offers only a broad resurrection contrast.

changed_reading.before: The occupants fail at a spatial escape.
changed_reading.after: Their motion is arrested emergence: every attempted birth into an outside is folded back before it can become a new stage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact tasting-punishment-burning cluster occurs at 22:9, and 22:10 immediately connects it to what the hands sent forward. When the cluster returns after أُعِيدُوا in the focus, the reset can be read as consequence cycling back to embodied agency.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure supplies the focus's explicit backward motion.
Experienced testing begins the earlier occurrence of the focus's sensory formula.
Punitive pain supplies the same object of tasting as in the focus.
Fire completes the exact earlier tasting-punishment-burning cluster.
Advancing something forward supplies the outbound action whose consequence can return.
What the hands acquire anchors the earlier punishment formula in embodied agency.

structural_cues: 22:9 reproduces the three-root sequence ذ و ق -> ع ذ ب -> ح ر ق.
22:10 follows with a causal deictic tied to what the two hands advanced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formulaic identity and an adjacent agency clause; I infer a forward-action/backward-consequence circuit, while the alternative is that the repetition only identifies the same punishment.

changed_reading.before: Return is imposed relocation back into a punishment.
changed_reading.after: Return also reads as enacted consequence coming back to its embodied source, where it must be experienced again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere will is coupled to effective entry and guidance, while 22:25 places human willing inside a bounded space, bends it toward deviation, and answers it with tasting. The focus's wish to exit is therefore not merely locomotion but a directional will met by a stronger counterdirection.

activation_trace.role: Intention and volition supply the focus's outward-directed agency.
Forced return supplies the counterdirection that defeats that agency.
Effective entry into an interior supplies a contrasting realized direction.
Unimpeded flow marks the interior produced by the effective will.
Will is paired there with action that reaches its intended outcome.
Will again selects an effective direction, this time toward guidance.
Contested willing sharpens the human intention inside the bounded place as a struggle of direction.
Inclination away from straightness gives that interior will a bent vector.
Experiential tasting is the answer to the misdirected interior will.

structural_cues: 22:14 and 22:16 pair will with accomplished action or guidance.
22:25 repeats willing, interior location, and punitive tasting before 22:22's same elements are encountered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting subjects and outcomes of will; I infer a hierarchy of directional agencies, while the alternative is to keep each occurrence semantically independent.

changed_reading.before: They want to leave, but an external force prevents the movement.
changed_reading.after: Their outward will enters a contest of directions: unlike effective will elsewhere, it is bent back and converted into renewed experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence wraps bodies in a fiery exterior, pours heated matter from above, melts inner and outer tissue, and supplies instruments of repulsion. The focus completes this as a vessel-process: pressure drives outward motion and the apparatus drives it back inside.

activation_trace.role: Covering and closure make the focus distress continuous with a sealed material surround.
Return supplies the recirculation step of the vessel-process.
Clothing and covering provide the process's fiery outer membrane.
Pouring supplies a directed input from above into the bounded body-space.
Melting by heat makes the input process both interior and exterior material.
Repulsion and forcible return provide the apparatus that cancels attempted exit.

structural_cues: 22:19-21 move from an enclosing garment, to a pour from above, through bellies and skins, to iron instruments.
22:22 follows with outward pressure, forced reinsertion, and renewed burning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, directional pouring, melting, repulsion, and return; I supply the vessel-and-recirculation arrow, while the alternative is a non-mechanical list of adjacent torments.

changed_reading.before: Hell is a place from which escape is blocked.
changed_reading.after: The place functions like a closed processing vessel: bodies are enclosed, penetrated, transformed, and mechanically recirculated when pressure drives them outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah replaces denied exit and forced return with caused entry into an interior characterized by flow. Both scenes have a فيها, but one recirculates occupants into burning while the other permits rivers to traverse its inside.

activation_trace.role: Attempted passage outward establishes the closed interior's blocked boundary.
Return restores occupants to the same interior rather than permitting through-flow.
Entry into an interior supplies the inverse boundary crossing immediately after the focus.
Flow and coursing make the contrasting interior permeable to sustained movement.
A river cutting ground with running water gives that movement a spatial channel.

structural_cues: 22:22 and 22:23 place opposed motion systems on either side of the ayah boundary.
The repeated interior pronoun فيها contains forced return in 22:22 and adornment in 22:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent closed and flowing interiors; I infer that circulation, not interiority alone, distinguishes them, while the alternative is a simple punishment-reward contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts being inside fire with being outside it.
changed_reading.after: The sharper contrast is between two interiors: one defeats circulation by returning every exit, while the next receives entrants and sustains flow through itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later distinction between seeing eyes and blind hearts inside breasts resolves ghamm's cover, heart-confusion, and obscured light into failed inner navigation. The wished-for exit remains spatially anchored, but the inability to orient is also internal.

activation_trace.role: Covered light supplies the perceptual darkness of the focus distress.
Distress and a confused affair lodge that darkness at the level of the heart and orientation.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies the later explicit model of inner disorientation.
The heart locates the disabling condition within the agent rather than only around the body.
The breast as a source from which actions issue makes failed navigation operational, not merely affective.

structural_cues: 22:46 explicitly relocates blindness from eyes to hearts situated inside breasts.
The focus places the outward wish immediately beside ghamm's covering and confusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies internal blindness and ghamm's heart-covering field; I infer impaired navigation as part of the escape loop, while the alternative keeps 22:46's epistemic blindness separate from 22:22's pain.

changed_reading.before: Pain motivates a clear attempt toward a physically blocked exit.
changed_reading.after: The loop also contains blinded inner navigation: the agent wants an outside while the very faculty that could orient toward it is covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later sequences provide recurrence that changes state or reaches a destination: night enters day and day enters night, life passes through death to life, and affairs return toward God. Against those patterns, the focus is an anti-cycle whose return produces neither alternate phase nor new terminus.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure supplies the focus recurrence into the same named interior.
A return-place or destination raises the question of what, if anything, the recurrence reaches.
Repeated entering and exiting supplies a reciprocal cycle in which each phase becomes another.
Return to what was supplies the surah's later explicitly directed return of all affairs.

structural_cues: 22:61 has reciprocal insertion of night into day and day into night.
22:66 sequences giving life, causing death, then giving life.
22:76 directs the return of all affairs toward God, whereas 22:22 repeats فيها as the unchanged destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transformative alternation and directed return; I use them as control patterns for recurrence, while the alternative is that the shared cyclic grammar has no interpretive force across these scenes.

changed_reading.before: The return is simply endless repetition.
changed_reading.after: It is recurrence deprived of what recurrence elsewhere accomplishes: no alternate phase, no renewal, and no movement beyond the same interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر د د mapping under focus root ر و د, not the ordinary volitional branch. It remains valid as a packet-exposed split-root activation and is anchored in أَرَادُوا beside أُعِيدُوا; downstream prose should label it a formal echo, not claim that the surface verb etymologically means return.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapping inserts return-to-place into the focus word for willing.
Repulsion and prevention make the wish formally carry its own blockage.
Repetition, oscillation, and perplexity make the volitional moment already loop-shaped.
The explicit passive return realizes the return-image activated inside the earlier wish.

changed_reading.before: A free-standing wish is subsequently defeated by return.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root echo, the wish already bears return, repulsion, and oscillation before the sentence explicitly sends its holders back.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because 22:73 concerns failed recovery of a stolen thing, not the focus occupants. It remains anchored through the focus's seeking-will and outward extraction, while the later ayah supplies rescue, weakness, seeker, and sought; downstream prose should present it as an analogy of disabled retrieval, not identify the two scenes.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and searching make escape a pursued object rather than a bare impulse.
Passage to the outside supplies the extraction the seeker pursues.
Extracting something from a predicament supplies the explicit rescue operation that fails.
Lack of strength disables the operation rather than merely placing the object far away.
Seeking and searching bind seeker and sought into one failed pursuit.
Distance that necessitates pursuit makes release remain structurally beyond the weakened seeker.

changed_reading.before: Escape is available in principle but blocked by a stronger guard.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, release is a failed retrieval system: seeker, sought exit, and extracting act are configured so the desired outside cannot be recovered.

strongest_changes: 22:5 turns exit-and-return into arrested emergence, an anti-birth that never reaches a next stage.
22:9-10 makes the exact tasting-punishment-burning formula legible as embodied consequence returning from what the hands advanced.
22:19-23 reconstructs two opposed interiors: a closed material processing vessel and an entered space that sustains flow.
22:46 and 22:61-76 add inner blindness and recurrence without transformation to the focus's escape loop.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context changed the focus from a static failed escape into several coexisting mechanisms: returned agency, arrested emergence, defeated directional will, material recirculation, occluded navigation, and an anti-cycle contrasted with flowing or transformative recurrence.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal reading of the repeated 22:9 formula depends on carrying 22:10's agency clause forward rather than treating the repetition as identification alone.
The anti-birth model compares spatial grammar in 22:22 with the developmental sequence in 22:5; the packet does not explicitly identify the two enclosures.
The self-returning-will outlier depends on a packet-authorized non-dominant mapping and should remain formally suggestive rather than lexical.
